reviewers.name: Architecture Reviewer
reviewers.responsibility: Check repo fit, boundaries, reuse, naming, and dependency discipline.

reviewers.name: Unit Test Reviewer
reviewers.responsibility: Check unit, integration, regression, and edge-case coverage.

reviewers.name: Accessibility Reviewer
reviewers.responsibility: Check keyboard flow, labels, focus, semantic structure, and result announcements.

reviewers.name: Security / Compliance Reviewer
reviewers.responsibility: Check dependency, data handling, policy, and enterprise compliance risks.

reviewers.name: Build Verifier
reviewers.responsibility: Run or recommend install, lint, tests, build, and smoke checks.

aggregator.name: Merge Arbitrator
aggregator.responsibility: Combine reviewer findings and decide continue, ask human, rework, or ready for review.
